name: MAGI-2-preview
description: MAGI-2-preview is Sand AI's open preview of MAGI-2, a research release focused on scaling video generation models efficiently. Rather than just posting weights, the repo documents and implements the efficiency techniques that make high-quality video generation tractable — a direction that matters as video models grow expensive to train and run. It targets researchers and engineers building the next generation of generative video systems.
highlights: Open preview of Sand AI's MAGI-2 video generation model
Focus on efficiency techniques for scaling video models
436 stars and growing in the generative-video space
curatorNote: Video generation is the most compute-hungry corner of generative AI, so a release that openly tackles efficiency is a rare and valuable contribution — the field needs this more than another set of weights.
